title: Javier's com tower bonus counts the towers he owns at each attack, even while his power is on
source: AWBW game 1563482, day 18 (replay ndx 102). Javier (Purple Lightning) has Tower of Power on. Sami uses Victory March and captures his only com tower in one action; then her 10 HP Md.Tank destroys his 9 HP Tank at (14,14). The position is that turn's file with the turn's first 16 actions applied (the capture, moves and fights before this attack). The kill needs a high luck roll with the tower gone; with the tower still counted, even the highest roll leaves the Tank alive, so the bonus dropped as soon as the tower changed hands. Spotted by Collin.
